function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the MOVEit Transfer exploitation campaign exclusively using evidence available through the benchmark research tools. Reconstruct the chronology from disclosure of the relevant vulnerability through mass exploitation, deployment of the LEMURLOOT web shell or malware, public attribution to FIN11 and/or CL0P, and any connection to CL0P-linked extortion infrastructure. Extract and preserve the exact source IDs returned by the benchmark for every factual statement. Determine, only where explicitly supported: precise dates; affected products and versions; vulnerability identifiers and descriptions; exploitation methods; LEMURLOOT names, behaviors, and deployment details; infrastructure, domains, servers, or extortion sites; actor names; attribution language and confidence; and relationships among actors, malware, infrastructure, and events. Carefully separate confirmed observations from vendor or analyst assessments, allegations, reported claims, and unresolved uncertainty. Identify competing attributions, temporal or factual contradictions, and missing or unknown dimensions. Do not infer identifiers, relationship names, dates, versions, or causal links that the evidence does not state. Return a structured evidence report with a chronological timeline, entity/relation inventory, attribution analysis, contradictions, and source-ID citations attached to each assertion. The report will be used to produce a final answer with Markdown and a fenced JSON object whose arrays are exactly findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions; each finding requires question, answer, supporting_entities, source_references; each claim requires claim and source_references; each reasoning step requires id, conclusion, premise_entities, premise_relations; each contradiction requires contradiction_id, description, source_references."}
function.name: ConductResearch
